abstract: The number of color receivers was greatly increased in Japan in 1966. The Tokyo Broadcasting System had predicted the necessity for a thorough redesign of facilities and established the detailed design targets by the end of 1962. The overall transmission characteristics were first set up by using eight parameters which affect the quality of the pictures received. These overall characteristics are divided into program production facilities, local transmitter and intercity microwave linkages. The program production facilities are divided into seven blocks and these are further divided into each individual unit of equipment to complete the entire system design targets. These design targets have proved very helpful for the further development of high-standard equipments. The methods of establishing the design targets are described.
